fields.help: What the scope selector and the Work view call it.
fields.label: Name

fields.help: Marks its sessions in the sidebar.
fields.label: Colour

fields.help: Its live sessions that you can see.
fields.label: Live sessions

fields.help: Of those, the ones waiting on a person: a question, a permission, a stop.
fields.label: Need you

fields.help: Who is in it, by role. Shown to its own people and the fleet's administrator.
fields.label: Members

fields.help: Estimated cost of its sessions today (UTC). Shown when you can see every session.
fields.label: Spent today

fields.help: Estimated cost of its sessions over the last 7 days.
fields.label: Last 7 days

fields.help: Estimated cost of its sessions this calendar month (UTC).
fields.label: This month

fields.help: Estimated cost of its sessions on each of the last 14 days (UTC), today last.
fields.label: Last 14 days

fields.help: Whose sessions spent it: today, the last 7 days and this month (UTC). Shown only to an admin who sees every session; otherwise it is hidden whole, never in part.
fields.label: By person

fields.help: What its admins should look at: a budget at 80% or past it (Fleet only warns; it never stops a session), a device that may prompt but is not trusted yet (trust it in Settings → Devices), sessions on its hosts nobody has claimed.
fields.label: Needs an admin

fields.help: Settings this org may set for itself; the rest of the fleet keeps its value. Inherit takes the fleet's again.
fields.label: Its own settings

fields.help: Which sessions belong to it: a GitHub owner (or one repository), a path prefix, or a host.
fields.label: Rules

params.label: Hosts allowed (optional; every host of the org when empty)
params.name: hosts

fields.help: The org's project catalog: a project its people work on, with its remote, where it is checked out and the hosts it may run on (none: every host of the org).
fields.label: Projects

fields.help: A host in an org: its per-host token reads only this org's (and unassigned) work.
fields.label: Hosts

fields.help: Trackers whose tickets belong to this org.
fields.label: Trackers

fields.help: The Claude accounts its hosts are signed in to. Add or switch one on Settings → Hosts.
fields.label: Accounts

fields.help: Asset catalogs this org owns; its hosts receive them. Add or remove one in Settings → Catalogs.
fields.label: Catalogs

fields.help: Phones, browsers and desktops bound to this org: they see only its work (and unassigned work, if allowed below). Pair a new one in Settings → Devices. Shown to the hub's operator only.
fields.label: Devices

params.label: Role
params.name: role
options: Member — sees its work and what is shared with it

fields.help: Who is in the company. An admin administers it (its settings, members and their devices); a member sees its work and what is shared with it; a viewer only reads. Nobody sees another person's private sessions.
fields.label: Members

remove.confirm: What was shared with them on this org's sessions is taken back too. Their own sessions stay theirs; if this was their last org, their devices see nothing of any org.
remove.label: Remove from the org

each.confirm: Every share they still hold on this org's sessions is taken back. The sessions' owners can share again.
each.label: Take back their shares

fields.help: Who left the company, and the shares on its sessions they still hold. Take those back here. Shown to its admins.
fields.label: Removed members

fields.help: Who is working on what: each member's live sessions in this org that you can see, with their state, and how many more are private.
fields.label: Team

each.confirm: They keep reading the session and can no longer answer or drive it.
each.label: Narrow to watch

fields.help: Every share on this org's sessions: whose session, with whom, at what level, since when. An admin can take one back or narrow it to watch, never widen it. A session you cannot see reads "a private session".
fields.label: Sharing

remove.confirm: They lose this session at once. Its owner can share it again.
remove.label: Revoke

fields.confirm: This org's admins will administer every host on the hub.
fields.help: This company owns the hub: its admins administer hosts — route them into orgs and see how many sessions on them nobody has claimed. One org at most. Only the hub's owner changes it.
fields.label: Owns this hub

fields.help: What you may do in it: an admin administers it, a member works in it, a viewer reads.
fields.label: Your role

fields.help: Its admins see how many sessions on its hosts nobody has claimed — a count, never the sessions. Off by default; only the hub's owner changes it.
fields.label: Admins see unclaimed sessions

fields.confirm: Hosts outside this org will no longer list or message its sessions, and its hosts will not see other orgs' sessions. It can break a controller that dispatches across companies.
fields.help: Also hide this org's sessions from other orgs' hosts, and theirs from its hosts: list, peer status, messages. Work data is fenced either way.
fields.label: Isolate sessions

fields.confirm: Its members will watch each other's sessions in this org: what each one's Claude is doing and has said. They still cannot answer or drive them without a share.
fields.help: On (the default): a member sees their own sessions and what is shared with them. Off: the org's members also watch each other's sessions in it — read only; answering or driving one still needs a share. Only the hub's owner turns it off; an org admin can turn it back on.
fields.label: Members see only their own sessions

fields.help: Auto-tidy for this org's sessions: on or off whatever the fleet-wide setting says, or inherit it. Safe kill only, never a session in use.
fields.label: Auto-tidy

fields.confirm: This org's redacted prompts and ticket titles will be sent to TypeSafe when Decisions (Jev) is on.
fields.help: Let this org's redacted prompts and ticket titles go to TypeSafe's decision model when Decisions (Jev) is on. Only ids and numbers are recorded; an answer is at most a suggestion.
fields.label: Allow Jev (decision model) for {title}'s work

fields.confirm: The end of this org's sessions' screens (Claude's reply text, redacted) will be sent to TypeSafe when Decisions (Jev) and its turn outcome use case are on.
fields.help: On top of Jev above: let the end of this org's sessions' screens — Claude's last reply, redacted, code replaced by placeholders, a few lines — go to TypeSafe's decision model, so Jev can tell a finished turn from a question when hooks say nothing. Off by default (D48).
fields.label: Also allow Claude's reply text (turn outcome)

fields.help: Devices paired to this org (fleet-hub pair --org) also see work and sessions that belong to no org, as a host does. Off: only this org's own.
fields.label: Bound devices see unassigned

resources.help: Optional. Name an org to merge or split GitHub owners, to attach a tracker, or to make it a boundary: a host in an org lets its Claude read only that org's (and unassigned) work.
resources.label: Organisation

delete.confirm: Its cached tickets go with it; sessions keep their keys and links.
delete.label: Remove tracker

resources.empty: No trackers. Keys in branch names group sessions without one; connect a tracker for titles and statuses.

resources.help: Trackers add a ticket's title and status to the sessions working on it, and list your tickets in ⌘K. Nothing needs one: keys in branch names group sessions without any tracker.

delete.confirm: Removes the catalog from fleet's config. Its checkout stays on disk; open cards on it are withdrawn.
delete.label: Remove

resources.empty: No catalogs yet. Add an org's catalog by its checkout path.

fields.help: Its git remote, if any.

fields.help: The org whose hosts receive it; none for personal.
fields.label: Org

fields.help: Hosts with no org that receive this catalog. Hosts of its org always do.

fields.help: Paired desktops that may change this catalog. Granted in Settings → Devices.

resources.help: Git repos of assets fleet syncs to hosts. `personal` is yours; an org's catalog reaches that org's hosts and the org-less hosts that admit it. A GitHub org with SSO must allow the catalog's deploy key — an org admin does that once in the org's settings. Which device may change a catalog is set in Settings → Devices.
resources.label: Catalog

delete.confirm: Its next request is refused and the name is free again. Pair it again to bring it back.
delete.label: Revoke

resources.empty: No paired devices. Pair a phone or a browser with Pair a device.

fields.help: How the apps and the audit name it. Its grants, catalogs and person follow a new name.
fields.label: Name

fields.help: Full drives sessions; answer only answers their questions and permission prompts and never types a prompt; watch only reads. A viewer's device watches only whatever it says here.
fields.label: Mode

fields.help: The device you are using now. It cannot revoke, untrust, bind, hand over or make itself read-only.
fields.label: This device

fields.confirm: Its prompts will reach agents unmarked, and it will be able to change the company's orgs, devices and settings.
fields.help: Its prompts and messages reach agents unmarked, and it may change the company's orgs, devices and settings. Trust a device you type on, never an agent's.
fields.label: Trusted

fields.confirm: From its next request it sees only the org picked here (every org, with none).
fields.help: The org it is bound to; none sees every org.
fields.label: Org

fields.confirm: From its next request it sees that person's sessions and the ones shared with them, and no others.
fields.help: Whose device it is: it sees their sessions and the ones shared with them.
fields.label: Belongs to

fields.help: A desktop or a phone, as its app last said.
fields.label: Kind

fields.help: What it runs, as its app last said; nothing until it has called the hub.

fields.help: Asset catalogs it may edit and sync. Only a full device bound to no org can hold one.

fields.help: Its last request to the hub.
fields.label: Last seen

fields.help: When it was paired.
fields.label: Paired

resources.help: The phones, browsers and desktops paired to the hub. A device bound to an org sees only that org's work; a trusted one's prompts reach agents unmarked, and it may change these settings. Links to other fleets' hubs are under Federation; updater tokens are managed on the hub.
resources.label: Device

delete.confirm: Revokes every device of theirs and every share made to them, at once. Their own sessions stay private and theirs. There is no re-enable.
delete.label: Disable

resources.empty: Nobody yet. Add a person, or pair a device to them.
